items.description: Profession Hub is a recruitment and human resources agency based in Wierdapark, Centurion, founded in February 2009. The company positions itself as an all-in-one destination for human resources and employee management, offering services across recruitment, labour relations, payroll and professional CV writing. Its recruitment service applies a structured selection process intended to match candidates with a company's vision and values, while its careers section is regularly updated with current vacancies for job seekers. Through its payroll service, Profession Hub aims to streamline clients' payroll processing for accuracy and timeliness, allowing business owners to focus on their core operations rather than administrative compliance. The agency markets itself as a comprehensive HR partner for South African businesses, combining recruitment support with ongoing employee-management services rather than offering a single, narrow service. Profession Hub operates from Wierdapark in Centurion and continues to publish recruitment-industry articles and career advice through its website, reflecting an ongoing focus on both employer recruitment needs and individual job seekers navigating the local labour market.

Promap Civil Engineering Surveys (Pty) Ltd. is a geospatial survey company based in Murrayfield, Pretoria, specialising in aerial imagery and LiDAR data collection. The company supplies high-resolution vertical and oblique aerial imagery to support mapping, planning, monitoring and analysis across a range of applications, and its aerial LiDAR technology delivers high-accuracy elevation data and detailed terrain models suited to infrastructure design and environmental monitoring. Promap also operates a mobile mapping solution, a vehicle-mounted system used to capture high-resolution imagery and 3D point clouds, and provides an online data-visualisation platform giving clients secure, intuitive access to imagery, 3D data, mobile-mapping outputs and their own survey data in a single workspace. The company describes its expertise as spanning the full range of aerial survey services, including vertical, oblique and LiDAR mapping, tailored to the needs of individual projects. Promap describes itself as having grown from modest beginnings into an established name in geospatial data, combining technology with hands-on survey experience to help clients make informed, data-driven decisions about their projects.

Pronk Aluminium CC is an aluminium manufacturing and installation company based in Koedoespoort Industrial, Pretoria, founded in March 2004. The company specialises in double-glazing and custom-made aluminium products, including windows, doors, folding doors, sliding doors and curtain walls, manufactured at its own factory and fitted by an in-house installation team supported by a dedicated fleet of vehicles. Pronk Aluminium is compliant with the Association of Architectural Aluminium Manufacturers of South Africa (AAAMSA) and is a member of the South African Glass and Glazing Association (SAGGA). Its completed project portfolio includes residential and commercial developments such as Hertford Park, Mooikloof, Walkersons Estate and work for the Royal Thai Embassy in Brooklyn. The company presents itself as a long-established name in the aluminium industry, built on a combination of factory-based craftsmanship and on-site installation capability, serving both private homeowners and commercial clients across the Pretoria area with made-to-order aluminium and glass products.

PS Branded, trading through its Portable Shade website, manufactures outdoor branding and event structures from its base in Rooihuiskraal North, Centurion. Its product range includes gazebos, banners, flags and branded furniture aimed at exhibitions, storefronts and outdoor activations. The gazebo range spans several sizes and styles, from the 2.5m Eco Shade, a low-peak pyramid-roof unit with an aluminium frame and PVC connectors, through to the high-peak Luxline range available in 2.8m, 3m, 4.2m and 4.5m x 3m configurations, as well as a 1.2m x 2.4m dome-roofed Pitlane model. Each gazebo is built on an aluminium frame with sliding leg units, and the company publishes specific pack sizes, storage heights and weights for each model, indicating a focus on portability and ease of transport and assembly. Alongside gazebos, PS Branded supplies printed banners, flags and a line described as Portabella industrial decor furniture, positioning the company as a supplier of branded, collapsible display equipment for events, expos and promotional activations rather than permanent signage.

items.description: Rassolutions, trading as RAS Solutions, is an accounting and consulting firm based in Amberfield Valley, Centurion, offering outsourced financial services to small businesses. Its accounting service covers financial statement preparation, transaction recording, balance sheet reconciliations and monthly management reporting, while its payroll offering includes payroll processing and administration of PAYE, UIF, SDL and EMP501 submissions. The firm's consulting arm assists business owners with business plans, company registration, annual returns, BEE certification and COIDA registration, and its taxation service covers the preparation and submission of VAT201 returns, withholding tax, provisional tax and income tax. Beyond financial services, Rassolutions also offers branding support, including product and company branding, website design, logo design and social media marketing, positioning itself as a single outsourced partner covering both compliance and brand-building needs for small and growing businesses. The firm describes its approach as affordable and accessible, aiming to simplify complex accounting and compliance requirements so that business owners can focus on running their operations rather than administrative tasks.

Rathidili Attorneys Inc. is a law firm based in Constantia Park, Pretoria East, practising across family law, personal injury, estate planning and trusts, business law, general litigation and compliance management. The firm positions itself as an alternative to large national and international practices, offering personalised service while aiming to match the standard of expertise associated with bigger firms. It offers flexible after-hours appointments and states that its attorneys can meet clients at a location of their choosing rather than requiring office visits during standard hours. Rathidili Attorneys describes itself as a young, vibrant practice that incorporates technology into its client service, with an emphasis on treating clients with dignity and respect throughout their legal matters. The firm's stated objective is to secure the best possible outcome for each client while providing a client-focused experience, combining the responsiveness of a smaller specialised practice with the depth of experience it attributes to its legal team.

Records Management SA is a document and information management company based in Hennopspark, Centurion, offering a range of services aimed at helping organisations manage physical and digital records. Its document scanning and digitisation service converts paper records into digital format to improve accessibility and retrieval, while its digital document management system provides cloud-based archiving with anytime access to stored data. The company also provides off-site document storage, allowing businesses to free up on-site office space previously used for filing cabinets and archive boxes, as well as document shredding for the secure, compliant destruction of confidential paperwork. In addition, Records Management SA offers computer recycling, handling the collection, transportation and processing of old electronic equipment with secure data wiping and destruction, and supports office relocations with move and storage services. Together, these services position the company as a single point of contact for businesses looking to digitise records, reduce physical storage needs and manage information security and compliance requirements.

REMIG Group is a resource management company based in Silvertondale, Pretoria, with its core focus on the utility sector. The company has been operating across Southern Africa since 1990 through a number of subsidiaries, and states that it remains managed by the founders of those subsidiary businesses. REMIG Group positions itself around sustainability within the utility business, describing its purpose as bringing sustainable practices to utility-sector operations across the region. While the company's website indicates that further detail on its specific service offering is still being developed, its long operating history in Southern Africa and continued management by its founding subsidiaries point to an established presence in utility-sector resource management rather than a recent market entrant. The company is based at its Silvertondale premises in Pretoria, from which it coordinates its subsidiary operations across the region.

Rex Diff and Gearbox Pretoria (RDG) is an automotive repair workshop based at the Montana Boulevard Lifestyle Centre in Magalieskruin, Pretoria, specialising in driveline repairs for both automatic and manual vehicles. The workshop's services include gearbox repairs and differential repairs as its core offering, alongside additional services such as propshaft balancing and repairs, clutch replacement, CV joint work and scheduled vehicle servicing. RDG Pretoria markets itself on its experienced team and purpose-built facilities, positioning the workshop as a specialist repair centre for drivetrain components rather than a general vehicle-service garage. Customers can request a quote through the company's website, and the workshop operates from its Magalieskruin premises serving vehicle owners across the northern parts of Pretoria who require gearbox or differential repair work, backed by a team focused specifically on driveline rather than broader mechanical work.

items.description: Rob's Spice is a spice and seasoning supplier based in Waltloo, Pretoria, trading since 2000 and operating today under its parent brand, Pure Food Products, also known as Pure Food ZA. The company describes itself as a dually owned supplier of seasonings, spices and a range of food ingredients and sauces, with more than 20 years of experience in the retail and wholesale food market. Its product offering is split across two ranges: the Pure Food range, which includes spice pouches, spice packets and spice grinders, and the Rob's Spice range, which includes spice tubs, soya mince, tomato and chilli sauce, and white and brown vinegar. The company states that its core values centre on integrity, efficiency, and product and service quality, and it positions its products as being competitively priced while remaining accessible to South African consumers and food businesses alike. Rob's Spice continues to operate from its original Waltloo base in Pretoria.

items.description: S F P Townplanning (Pty) Ltd, operating under the registered name Smit & Fisher Planning (Pty) Ltd, is a town planning consultancy based in Nieuw Muckleneuk, Pretoria. The firm specialises in town planning, land use approvals and strategic property development, and extends its planning expertise into telecommunications infrastructure and outdoor advertising as well as renewable energy project development. Its stated focus is on delivering planning solutions across South Africa, covering the consultative and regulatory steps involved in securing land use approvals for property and infrastructure projects. The firm markets itself with the tagline 'Planning the Future. Delivering Possibility,' reflecting a focus on guiding clients through planning processes for both conventional property development and newer infrastructure categories such as telecommunications and renewable energy installations across the country.

SADC Mining Supplies is a supplier of mining, industrial, agricultural, construction and automotive engineering equipment, based in Thatchfield, Centurion, and operating since 2017. The company describes itself as a bridge between mining companies and the day-to-day supplies their operations require, serving customers across Southern African countries. Its stated focus is on delivering the right product, at the right cost, to the right place and at the right time, with an emphasis on reliable delivery despite logistical challenges across the region. SADC Mining Supplies positions manufacturing and supply as central to economic development in the sectors it serves, aiming to help mining and manufacturing businesses in the SADC region reach their operational potential. The company operates from its Thatchfield Gardens premises in Centurion, from which it coordinates supply to customers across its specialisation areas in the mining, industrial, agricultural, construction and automotive sectors.

Sakabuka Kennels is a pet boarding facility based in Derdepoort, Pretoria, offering accommodation for dogs and cats as well as other small animals such as birds, hamsters, snakes and lizards. Pet owners booking a stay are asked to provide the animal's name, weight (for dogs) and the dates of the stay, and owners of animals with specific dietary needs are asked to bring sufficient food to cover the length of the visit. A heater can be requested for an animal's accommodation at the time of booking. The kennels operate during set office hours: Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 17:00, and Saturday, Sunday and public holidays from 10:00 to 14:00, with no after-hours drop-off or collection available. The facility is closed for drop-offs and collections on 25 December and 1 January. Bookings are made directly with the kennels, reflecting a small, personally run boarding operation focused on individual care for each animal in its charge.

Sapience Communications is a communication and research company based in Amandasig, Pretoria, operating under the motto 'Brilliance Through Meticulous Packaging.' The company states that its vision is to be recognised as a communication and research business that promotes access to information while smoothing communication channels between service providers and clients. Its stated mission is to apply communication and research methods and tools to deliver innovative, proactive and solution-oriented services tailored to each client's needs. Sapience Communications is accessible to clients through its website, email and social media platforms, and also conducts physical interactions with clients where this is considered necessary. The company attributes its service capability to a team it describes as comprising subject matter experts across political, social, economic, technological and legal fields, and states that it enters into partnerships to extend its service offering, positioning itself as a boutique communications and research consultancy.

Sarel Venter Custom Knives is a knife sharpening, repair and manufacturing business based in Eloffsdal, Pretoria. The company sharpens and repairs blades for hunting, fishing, cooking and crafting use, and also offers customised sharpening services for scissors and kitchen knives. In addition to sharpening and repair work, it manufactures custom knives and sources knives from various parts of the world for sale to customers, with products such as a chef's knife listed in its online shop. The business also hosts knife-making courses, allowing customers to learn the craft of producing their own blades under guidance from an experienced knifemaker. Sarel Venter Custom Knives presents itself as a specialist operation built on industry experience, emphasising quality workmanship, competitive pricing and fast turnaround times across its sharpening, repair and custom knife-making services for customers across South Africa.

SavantCo is a business and taxation solutions provider based in Eloffsdal, Pretoria, offering bookkeeping and tax services to small startups, growing businesses and established entrepreneurs. The company uses cloud-based accounting software and structured accounting practices to keep clients' financial records accurate and current, and states that it keeps up to date with changing tax regulations and deductions in order to minimise clients' tax liabilities and maximise their returns. SavantCo positions itself as a personalised financial partner, saying it takes the time to understand each client's specific financial circumstances rather than applying a one-size-fits-all approach. The company frames its core offering around three themes: accuracy and efficiency in financial record-keeping, staying current on tax rules to optimise outcomes for clients, and a personal, relationship-based approach to service delivery, aimed at businesses seeking an outsourced bookkeeping and tax partner.

Scaffold For Sale is a supplier of refurbished scaffolding and formwork based in Silverton, Pretoria. The company's equipment undergoes a thorough inspection and restoration process before resale, including repairs, removal of rust and cement residue, and anti-oxidation treatment, with a licensed specialist issuing a safety and compliance certificate for each batch of refurbished equipment to confirm it meets SABS standards. Scaffold For Sale positions its refurbished stock as offering significant savings compared with buying new equipment, and it also runs a flexible buy-back programme for customers. Among its product range is the Quickstage scaffolding system, a standard wedge-fixing scaffold widely used in the construction industry for access purposes, for which the company offers free consultations and cost estimates. The business states that it delivers its certified, refurbished scaffolding and formwork equipment to customers across Africa, positioning itself as a cost-effective alternative to new equipment for contractors and construction businesses needing certified access scaffolding.

Sekretari (Pty) Ltd is a company secretarial and statutory compliance firm based in Centurion Central, founded in 1984 and operating in the secretarial services space for several decades since. The firm assists companies with the requirements of the Companies Act 71 of 2008, which obliges companies to appoint a company secretary knowledgeable in the relevant laws, by providing training for client staff as well as ongoing consulting and support on statutory compliance matters. Clients can outsource some or all aspects of their statutory compliance to Sekretari, which the firm says reduces the compliance burden otherwise carried by company directors under the Act. The firm charges for outsourced statutory compliance work on a pay-for-time-used basis, rather than requiring clients to carry the cost of underutilised full-time staff. Sekretari also makes recordings of past webinars on statutory and compliance topics available to clients who have missed a live session, supporting its positioning as a long-established specialist in company secretarial services.

Sheerline also offers related services including powder coating, delivery, die design and extrusion, and its Starfront and U-Solve systems, along with certification and training support for installers and fabricators working with its products. The company states its objective is to become the leading distributor of window, door, shopfront and curtain-walling systems to fabricators across Africa, aiming to provide an efficient, reliable single source for aluminium-related products alongside supplementary glass and hardware items. Beyond its Hennopspark branch, Sheerline operates additional branches in Johannesburg, Cape Town, East London, Durban and George, reflecting a national distribution network for its aluminium systems.

Signs Value is a signage and printing company based in Doornpoort, Pretoria, offering branding and company identity solutions. The business manufactures Chromadek signs and lightboxes built to customer specifications, and also provides wide-format printing on a range of materials up to 1320mm in width. Customers place orders by sending an email or otherwise contacting the company with their requirements, after which Signs Value manufactures the goods, typically completing production within around seven working days before arranging delivery or installation at the customer's chosen location. The company describes itself as continually building its knowledge of signage and branding products in order to help customers establish a distinct company identity and stand out from competitors. Signs Value positions itself as a single-point supplier covering design guidance, manufacturing and delivery or installation for signage and wide-format print projects across the Pretoria area.

SignTec is a signage, branding and printing company based in Raslouw, Centurion, with a team describing itself as having 24 years of combined industry experience. The company states that it has been providing printing and signage services for more than 20 years, with all design and manufacturing carried out in-house. SignTec manages projects through its own team from initial consultation and quotation through to design, manufacturing, installation and rollout, without outsourcing stages of production to third parties. The company positions its offering around quality workmanship, guaranteed through high-quality materials, alongside competitive pricing and a customer service approach intended to consistently meet client deadlines. SignTec describes its staff as a close-knit, in-house team, each accountable for their role in the company's established production process, and states that it has supplied custom signage to a range of established brands as part of its client base.

Sildale Park is an industrial and commercial property offering small, medium and large factories, offices and warehouses to let in Silverton (Silvertondale), Pretoria. The park is owned by Presmooi (Pty) Ltd, which forms part of the listed property group Octodec Investments Ltd, and is managed on a day-to-day basis by City Property Administration (Pty) Ltd. Available space at the park is let directly to tenants, with current vacancies and letting information published on the park's own website. The property's management has published a fraud alert warning prospective and existing tenants that its banking details have not changed, directing anyone in doubt to contact the park directly rather than relying on unsolicited emails. For businesses requiring additional industrial space in the Silverton area beyond what is available at Sildale Park, the same management group also points prospective tenants toward Tannery Industrial Park as a further letting option in the vicinity.

Simply Moves is a furniture and office removals company based in Erasmusrand, Pretoria, offering long- and short-distance household and office furniture removals across all South African provinces as well as general transportation of goods. Every move includes free goods-in-transit insurance, and the company's vehicles are fitted with tracking devices to help safeguard customers' furniture while in transit. Simply Moves also provides secure storage facilities in Centurion and Midrand, protected by 24-hour security and camera surveillance, for customers who need to store furniture before, during or after a move. Its packing service includes professional packing and wrapping, with the company supplying boxes, bubble wrap and plastic covers for mattresses and couches, and staff trained to handle fragile household items. The company operates a range of truck sizes to accommodate both small and large moves, and emphasises client communication, professionalism and flexibility throughout the moving process as central to its service.

Skynatics Security is a security technology supplier based in Hennopspark, Centurion, specialising in CCTV camera systems, alarm systems and access control solutions. The company supplies established security brands and supports installers, technicians and trade professionals by assisting with product selection and compatibility for individual projects. Skynatics Security caters to both small and large installations, providing solutions for residential, commercial, industrial and retail applications, and operates an online store through which customers and trade partners can purchase its security products directly. The company states that its commitment includes building long-term relationships with installers and trade partners, positioning itself as a supplier that supports the broader security installation trade rather than only engaging directly with end customers. Through this approach, Skynatics Security aims to provide reliable security technology covering homes, businesses and other spaces requiring surveillance, access control or alarm protection.

Solem Solar is a solar system design and installation company based in Wapadrand, Pretoria, describing itself as having over six years of experience delivering solar energy solutions for homes and businesses. The company designs bespoke solar systems aimed at residents and businesses seeking to reduce the impact of loadshedding, hedge against rising electricity costs, or increase the value of their properties. Its loadshedding-focused systems are aimed at property owners wanting backup power during outages, with an entry-level system priced at around R22,000, sufficient to keep essential items such as lights, a television, laptops and internet connections running during an outage. Solem Solar frames investment in solar energy as a long-term benefit to a property as well as a contribution to environmental sustainability. The company also addresses common customer questions on its website, such as how to transition from a grid-based system to solar, noting that a modular approach, such as starting with solar water heating and a small inverter and battery system, is often more cost-effective than converting a property to solar power entirely at once.

Soliad (Pty) Ltd is a civil engineering and construction company based in Raslouw, Centurion, established in 2014. The company's team states it has more than 20 years of combined experience in civil engineering and construction, delivering projects spanning roadworks, stormwater management and earthworks. In addition to general civil infrastructure work, Soliad has undertaken mining-related construction projects, including mining platforms, roadworks and the construction of stores for mining operations. The company also operates a plant hire division, renting out tractor-loader-backhoes, excavators, trucks and water bowsers to other contractors and businesses. Soliad describes its core values as quality, integrity, innovation, sustainability, family values and community engagement, and states its mission is to deliver innovative, sustainable civil engineering and construction solutions that support community development. The company positions itself as a multifaceted civil engineering contractor serving both conventional construction clients and the mining sector from its base in the Centurion area.

items.description: TaaSA Group, short for Trailers-as-a-Service Africa, is a fleet maintenance business based in Doornpoort, Pretoria, built around supporting truck and trailer operators across Africa. The company's stated purpose is to develop local, black-owned small and medium-sized businesses by bringing them into the truck and trailer maintenance and refurbishment value chain, helping them implement a cost-effective maintenance service plan intended to improve safety, protection and profitability for fleet operators. It also maintains a single up-to-date version of training documents, so that all users see the latest content rather than outdated material, positioning Teachme LMS as a comprehensive training and certification platform for organisations wanting their own branded learning environment.

The Gas Company is an LPG gas supplier based in Hennopspark, Centurion, trading under the tagline 'Everything Gas Since 1947.' The business offers gas bottle exchanges and refills, compliant gas installations intended to satisfy insurer requirements, and gas-powered home appliances, positioning itself as an alternative to reliance on state-supplied electricity. Through its GasOnTapp mobile app, available on the Google Play Store, customers can schedule gas refill orders for a specific time, pay through an in-app wallet, and avoid queuing or travelling to a store to place an order; new users registering through the app receive a credit toward their first order. The app is also linked to the company's loyalty programme. The Gas Company also offers a lease option for gas appliances and equipment, described as having no hidden fees and no deposit required. The business states that it operates seven days a week, including Sundays, reflecting a focus on convenience and uninterrupted supply for customers seeking to reduce their dependence on grid electricity.

The HR Nephew is a human resources and people-strategy consultancy based in Midstream Ridge, Centurion, describing itself as a South African leader in people strategy, people management, organisational performance and development, talent management and change management. The consultancy provides value-added people and talent management solutions to businesses nationally, stating that it works to understand each client organisation's specific needs and culture before developing recommendations. The firm is led by a professional who progressed from a graduate-in-training position up to HR executive and non-executive board member over the course of their career, and the consultancy applies that operational HR experience to help client businesses extend and leverage their existing workforce expertise. The HR Nephew states its vision is to be a first-choice, value-adding leader in human resources consulting and people management in South Africa, with a stated mission of empowering organisations and engaging talent, serving a client base it describes as including well-regarded South African organisations.

The Millennial Company is a software development studio based in Waterkloof Glen, Pretoria, describing itself simply as 'a development company.' Its services span mobile app development for iOS and Android, system integration work, bespoke software platform solutions, and digital advertising boards that clients can control through a dashboard or mobile app. The studio positions itself as a full-service operation combining design and development disciplines, with a team it describes as forward-thinking across both areas. Its platform solutions are aimed at centralising a client's existing systems to improve operational efficiency, while its mobile app work is developed natively for each operating system, with custom user interface and user experience design for each build. Project work referenced by the company includes platform solutions built for organisations such as Riversands Relay, DEHN and GH-Photo, and mobile apps developed for Crawdaddys, MeToU and Delivery Ways Appetite, reflecting a focus on bespoke digital products built for specific client businesses.
